name: Nickie
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Nickie founded Aurix AI Solutions with a vision to build enterprise AI platforms rooted in transparency, security, and human-centric design. With over 25 years of experience in enterprise architecture, she leads the company's strategic direction and product vision from the Pacific Northwest super-cluster.

name: Eric
title: Chief Technology Officer
bio: Eric serves as Enterprise Cloud Architect and CTO, overseeing the technical architecture and engineering direction of the Aurix platform. Based in the Seattle/Issaquah corridor, he leads the development of core infrastructure, AI orchestration, and cloud-native systems.
